checks.note: API docs confirm Bearer API key from /dashboard/api-keys. MCP docs confirm OAuth 2.1 (Claude and ChatGPT, scope mcp:access) plus Bearer sk_ key. The 'dynamic registration for Claude; static client ID/secret for ChatGPT' detail was not on the fetched page, so I removed it. OAuth2 is legitimately for MCP access, not REST.

Homepage: 100 free credits, no card; Monthly $5 for 1,000 credits at 200 RPM; Annual $4.50/mo billed $54/yr at 300 RPM; top-ups need an active subscription. Docs confirm free endpoints still need at least one active credit. Self-serve free holds for evaluation.

Docs list 13 REST endpoints (10 credit-based, 3 free) covering transcript, video metadata, search, channel and playlist reads. REST only. Breadth 'moderate' is a judgment call: read-only and YouTube-only, but a full read set. The /api/v2/ path prefix was not shown on the fetched page.
MCP docs: server at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp, 12 tools, hosted and operated by TranscriptAPI, so official.

ready_with_caveats fits: credit-metered, read-only, rate-limited. Claim that MCP tool names are inconsistent between doc pages was not verified, so I dropped it. ToS and reliability risk remains unassessed.

corrected.one_liner: TranscriptAPI is a hosted REST API and MCP server that returns YouTube video transcripts, search results, and channel and playlist data without a YouTube Data API key.
corrected.auth_notes: REST API: API key from the dashboard (/dashboard/api-keys), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. The MCP server also supports OAuth 2.1 (scope mcp:access) for Claude and ChatGPT, or the same API key as a Bearer token. OAuth applies to the MCP connector, not a general third-party app OAuth flow on the REST API.
corrected.access_notes: The free tier gives 100 credits with no card required, per the homepage. Paid plans: Monthly at $5/month for 1,000 credits (200 RPM); Annual at $4.50/month billed $54/year (300 RPM). Keys come from /dashboard/api-keys. Free endpoints still need at least one active credit. Top-up credits require an active subscription.
corrected.blocker: The API is read-only and credit-metered (1 credit per successful call on paid endpoints, 100 free credits). Rate limits are 200-300 RPM per account. The service is a third-party YouTube data layer, so YouTube ToS risk and reliability were not assessed. Scope is YouTube transcripts and metadata only.
